t: NBT Storage is custom block that allow input/output custom data to block. Mostly provided for ID support.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/nbt_storage/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
NBT存储器是一种自定义方块，支持向方块输入/输出自定义NBT数据，主要为ID兼容性而提供。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/nbt_storage/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your NBT Storage to a computer to make use of it!
将你的NBT存储器连接至计算机即可使用！
